context:
Answered in chat to the session-messaging topic session, 09:33 CST Nov 10: every message goes through the git mailbox, cloud to cloud included ("everything on one side"). This replaces the decision's line "Cloud to cloud keeps send_message".

Cloud send_message stays only as a short "check your mail" doorbell, so an idle session wakes: the mailbox is read at turn start and cannot wake anyone.

Your reason: a "delivered" send_message is not a read, it leaves no copy, and it differs from local SendMessage.

At 09:36 CST you said you are unsure the doorbell should be the cloud's direct session-to-session message, since it would not work on every device. So "every message through the mailbox" stands, and how a sender knows a message arrived is asked as a separate question.

The build of the mailbox route waits for the freeze (09:18 CST) to lift.
